title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in the xdg-desktop-portal package allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames. This portal service is used by flatpak and exposes D-Bus interfaces for file access and other operations. Red Hat has issued an important security update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to address this issue.
